name: retailops.mobile.roles
description: Authoritative role context for the RetailOps Android app. Every screen prompt, registry entry and validator derives its role block from this file. Agents must not invent roles, labels or language registers.

abbreviations.$comment: Shorthand used in 03-screen-inventory.md. Expanded by tools/build-registry.mjs.

internal.label: RetailOps
internal.registerRule: Internal terminology is allowed (PESM task, SLA breach, ruleset, scraper, ASIN Manager). Be concise and dense. The reader is a colleague who knows the system.
internal.shellLine: Top app bar: a rounded "All sellers" chip with a dropdown caret on the left, a search icon, a notification bell with a badge showing 3, and a circular avatar on the right. Bottom navigation bar with 5 items: Home, Catalog, Growth, Ops, More.

seller.label: RetailOps Seller
seller.registerRule: Plain merchant language only. See glossary.forbidden. The reader is a paying client, not a colleague. Never expose internal machinery.
seller.shellLine: Top app bar: the seller name "Seller A" with a small "Seller" chip beneath it, and a notification bell on the right. There is no seller switcher. Bottom navigation bar with 5 items: Home, Performance, My Products, Requests, More.

global.label: All sellers
global.rule: Seller switcher offers All sellers plus every seller.

assigned.label: Assigned sellers
assigned.rule: Seller switcher offers only assigned sellers. No All sellers option.

self.label: Own account
self.rule: Pinned to one seller. No switcher anywhere on the surface.

admin.uiNote: Sees every destination. This is the reference experience.

operational_manager.uiNote: Everything except Users, Roles, API keys and System settings.

Brand Manager.uiNote: Assigned sellers only. No dashboard, ads or chat permissions today (schema gap G-1/G-2/G-3).

catalog_manager.uiNote: Catalog and tasks. Export-heavy, read-mostly elsewhere.

listing_team.uiNote: Field users. Short, frequent sessions. Tasks are the primary job.

reviewer.uiNote: Approval-only. No permissions are seeded for this role today (gap G-6).

viewer.uiNote: Read-only. No permissions are seeded for this role today (gap G-6).

seller_client.uiNote: Proposed role (05-role-ui-matrix.md §5). Does not exist in the database yet; the seller surface cannot ship until it does.

ALL_AUTHENTICATED.promptLabel: any signed-in user, internal or seller

ALL_SURFACES.promptLabel: any signed-in user, internal or seller

glossary.$comment: Language contract. C-31 enforces the forbidden list on the seller surface.

forbidden.internal user name with no context: name plus role, e.g. "Priya Sharma · your account manager"
